guideSections.title: Moss Grotto, The Marrow, Silk Spear, & Bell Beast
detours: 1 · Skip the Beastfly arena shortcut; clear the arena and collect Shard Pendant.
2 · Collect Shard Pendant on the climb after the Marrow arena and toll bench. Equip it for early Shell Shard income.
3 · Take the Frayed Rosary String below the left Silk Wall, collect the Choral Commandment through Mosshome’s hidden top-left exit, and activate the return lift.
guideSections.note: Keep Hunter and use Shard Pendant for early supplies. The Bone Bottom spool is collected on the later loop after Lace 1 through its trapdoor and lift passage.

guideSections.title: Deep Docks, Swift Step, & Lace 1
detours: 1 · Marrow Craftmetal near the jail — planned for our tool budget.
2 · Toll bench — decided to skip after Swift Step; its Weaver spire is your respawn point. Go straight to Lace.
3 · Deep Docks Bellway — planned, 40 rosaries.

guideSections.title: Backtrack to Bone Bottom for Mask Shards
detours: 1 · After opening Deep Docks Bellway, farm the little Sharka loop to 710 rosaries before buying Pebb’s shard (25 per ~25 seconds).
guideSections.note: Collect the Bone Bottom spool; the original map does not mark spools.

guideSections.title: Far Fields, Drifter's Cloak, and Fourth Chorus
detours: 1 · Warding Bell bronze-pipe branch — decided to skip.
2 · Flying-bomber Craftmetal room beyond Warding Bell — decided to skip. Collect the planned Marrow and Blasted Steps Craftmetals for Magma Bell and Cogfly.
guideSections.note: Take the lowest right exit toward the Seamstress. Skip G&Z Detour 1 (Warding Bell) and Detour 2 (flying-bomber Craftmetal). Collect the hidden 60-rosary string near the Seamstress for the first Mort visit.

guideSections.title: Greymoor, Garmond and Zaza, & Moorwing
checkpoints: 3 · Craw Lake arena — decided to skip
4 · Thread Storm and Three-fold Pin — decided to skip
5 · Bell #3 — return after Widow with Cling Grip via upper Halfway Home
detours: 1 · Greymoor Bellway locket 478035 — planned; distinct from the skipped Faydown ledge locket.
2 · First G&Z conversation — exhaust dialogue.
3 · Reaper Crest — decided to skip.
4 · Craw Lake branch — decided to skip.
guideSections.note: Take the Bellway locket on the first pass. Skip the separate Halfway Home ledge locket 478039. Return for Bell #3 and the Greymoor spool after Cling Grip; keep Craw Lake arena, Thread Storm and Three-fold Pin skipped. Accept Moorwing aid if offered, but do not stall the route if the duo remains absent.

guideSections.title: Shellwood, 6th Mask, Cling Grip, & Widow
checkpoints: 1 · Shellwood mask shard — completes six masks if all four early shards were collected
2 · Sister Splinter — fight on our chosen route
detours: 1 · At the lift bottom, open the right-hand shortcut before continuing left.
2 · Open the Widow bench shortcut — planned.
guideSections.note: Use Joseph’s unmarked screenshot with the recovered navigation details below: lower right exit for the mask shard, upper right exit for the Cling Grip room, normal Sister Splinter fight, then the Gahlia room’s top-right exit. Open the upper Bellhart wall shortcut before Widow.

guideSections.title: Weavenest Atla, Wanderer Crest, and Deep Docks Mask Shard
detours: 1 · Eva’s Hunter evolution — planned.
guideSections.note: Your route also collects the Atla spool in the upper passage.

guideSections.title: Weavenest Atla, Wanderer Crest, and Deep Docks Mask Shard
detours: 1 · Loddie’s target practice — planned after Widow.
2 · Forge Daughter — planned for the kit and Magma Bell.
guideSections.note: The guide’s return map is missing; the displayed Deep Docks screenshot is from the first pass.

guideSections.title: Split Routes: Last Judge or the Mist
detours: 1 · Early Dice minigame — decided to skip; collect Dice free later.
2 · Free Craftmetal before Judge — planned.
3 · Underworks / Delver’s Drill — decided to skip.
guideSections.note: Joseph’s supplied screenshot covers Shellwood Bellway, Blasted Steps, Last Judge and the Grand Gate shortcut. Its map pins do not use the guide’s checkpoint numbering; follow the written steps and pins for the Choral Chambers bench and Grand Gate spool.

guideSections.title: Combined Route to Songclave, Lower Cogwork, and WV Arena
checkpoints: 1 · Possible G&Z sighting — no separate encounter search on our path
guideSections.note: The supplied red route covers Grand Gate through Choral Chambers, Grand Bellway and the Songclave approach. The Dancers, lower Core and Vaults arena still use their existing references. Our path uses the Greymoor conversation, roof duel and Forum offer. No separate Choral Chambers encounter was reported on the successful scout or timed file, so do not add a search loop here.

guideSections.title: Whispering Vaults, 7th Mask, Needle Upgrade, & Trobbio
checkpoints: 3 · Trobbio — after Needle Upgrade #2 on our path
4 · Needle upgrade #2 — collect before Trobbio on our path
detours: Bellhart upgrade and Blasted Steps Dice return — planned together after Pale Oil, before Trobbio.
guideSections.note: Keep the original map numbers; our directions take the Needle upgrade and free Dice before Trobbio. The screenshot covers the shard and Pale Oil; the preceding arena map is unavailable.

guideSections.title: The Cauldron, Clawline, Melody #1, & Outer Songclave
checkpoints: 3 · Vaultkeeper’s Melody cylinder — collect, then return to learn it
detours: Whiteward · Injector Band — planned with the White Key.
1 · Craftmetal puzzle before Clawline — decided to skip; the Blasted Steps Craftmetal is reserved for Cogfly.
2 · Locket below Trobbio’s lift — decided to skip; collect the planned wind-route locket.
3 · Wind-route locket — planned.
4 · Return to the Vaultkeeper to learn the melody; turn in spare cylinders for rosaries.
guideSections.note: Buy the 450-rosary kit after Clawline and collect the eastern Underworks spool. Reserve the Blasted Steps Craftmetal for Cogfly and take the wind-route locket. Open the roof gate and learn the melody before the roof duel. If cash is short, the roof has a 220-rosary necklace above the left exit.

guideSections.title: High Halls, Garmond and Zaza, & Melody #2
detours: 1 · Extra G&Z search / late Dice return — decided to skip; follow the roof-duel route and collect Dice on the earlier upgrade trip.
2 · G&Z roof duel and post-duel dialogue — planned.
guideSections.note: Our path completes the roof duel before entering High Halls. Exhaust post-duel dialogue, then accept help at the Forum door. Keep Straight Pin + Cogfly, Mirror + Injector Band, and Belt + Dice; Thread Storm remains skipped.

guideSections.title: Cogwork Core, Melody #3, Lace 2, & Grand Mother Silk
detours: Cradle 1 · Open the final bench shortcut — planned.
Cradle 2 · Shell Shard rock — optional supply stop only if needed.
guideSections.note: Your optional Fractured Mask trip is described below the directions at Prepare for Lace 2.

sections.title: Moss Grotto, The Marrow, Silk Spear, & Bell Beast
sections.summary: Collect Shard Pendant, the Mosshome resources and Silkspear, then defeat Bell Beast and ring the Marrow bell.

guide: Follow Moss Grotto into the Marrow and clear the arena; skip G&Z Detour 1 (Beastfly pogo shortcut).
On the climb after the arena and toll bench, take the free Shard Pendant from the side room. Equip it at a bench for extra Shell Shards from enemy kills.
Continue through Mosshome and collect Silkspear.
Take the Frayed Rosary String beneath the left Silk Wall. Break the wall by Mosshome’s top-left room transition and collect the Choral Commandment for a later Bellhart sale.
Activate the lift for the return to Mosshome, then continue toward Bell Beast. Keep the starting Hunter Crest.
Defeat Bell Beast and ring the Marrow bell.
Save rosaries for the planned shops and Bellways: skip maps, Quill, and Compass unless you need a map to find the route.
stops.title: Silkspear
stops.tip: Collect and equip Shard Pendant, take the Mosshome rosary string and Choral Commandment, and activate the return lift. Keep Hunter, defeat Bell Beast and ring the Marrow bell.

sections.title: Deep Docks, Swift Step, & Lace 1
sections.summary: Collect Straight Pin and the Marrow Craftmetal, get Swift Step, defeat Lace 1 and ring the Deep Docks bell.

guide: Pick up Straight Pin above Grindle’s cell on the way into Deep Docks.
Collect the Marrow Craftmetal from the trapped secret tunnel near the jail; reserve it for Magma Bell.
Clear the Deep Docks ant arena and collect Swift Step. Loddie’s target practice comes on the return after Widow.
Swift Step sets your respawn point at the Weaver spire. Skip G&Z Detour 2 (toll bench) and go straight to Lace; a death returns you to the spire as long as you have not rested at another bench.
Defeat Lace 1 and ring the Deep Docks bell. The Bone Bottom loop comes next.
stops.title: Swift Step
stops.tip: Collect Straight Pin and the Marrow Craftmetal for Magma Bell, then clear the ant arena for Swift Step. Skip G&Z Detour 2 (toll bench) and head straight to Lace; Swift Step’s spire is your respawn point until a later bench rest. Defeat Lace, ring the Deep Docks bell, and continue to the Bone Bottom loop.

sections.title: Backtrack to Bone Bottom for Mask Shards
sections.summary: After Lace 1, open Deep Docks Bellway, farm to 710, then take the Wormways, Pebb and Bone Bottom spool loop.

guide: Open Deep Docks Bellway for 40 rosaries.
Take the Bellway to the Marrow. Farm the little Sharka loop (G&Z Detour 1) to 710 rosaries (25 per ~25 seconds).
Collect the free Wormways mask shard below the Simple Key door, then buy Pebb’s mask shard for 300 rosaries.
Collect the Bone Bottom spool: go through the trapdoor, use the lift lever, and cross the trapped passage above town. This is the first half of pair A.
Return to Deep Docks, then Far Fields; collect the Seamstress’s 60-rosary string.
stops.title: Lace 1 defeated
stops.tip: Open Deep Docks Bellway (40), then farm to 710 rosaries before collecting the Wormways shard, buying Pebb’s shard (300), and taking the Bone Bottom spool. Return to Deep Docks for Far Fields.
stops.shoppingNote: Pay 40 for Deep Docks Bellway, then farm to 710: 300 for Pebb and 410 reserved for Mort and Greymoor. Collect the Seamstress’s 60-rosary string on the way.

sections.title: Far Fields, Drifter's Cloak, and Fourth Chorus
sections.summary: Collect the cloak and mask shard, then defeat Fourth Chorus on the return.

guide: In the tall Far Fields room, take the lowest right exit and pass Fourth Chorus to reach the Seamstress’s bench. Skip G&Z Detour 1 (Warding Bell) and Detour 2 (flying-bomber Craftmetal).
Take the Seamstress’s spine quest, collect the spines, and return for Drifter’s Cloak.
Collect the hidden 60-rosary string at the bottom of the air stream in the bottom-right of the Seamstress’s room. Consume it before Mort to fund the early purchases; this pickup is planned.
For the mask shard, climb the right side above the Seamstress to the top-right opening, then glide left with the currents and enter the upper-left puzzle room. Collect it before leaving Far Fields.
Return to Fourth Chorus and defeat it, then climb the tall room to Pilgrim’s Rest.
Pay the 30-rosary Pilgrim’s Rest entry and break the door gear from inside.
Buy Weighted Belt for 160 rosaries and the Tool Pouch for 220 on this first Mort visit.
Continue up into Greymoor toward Halfway Home.
stops.title: Drifter's Cloak
stops.tip: Take the lowest right exit toward the Seamstress. Skip G&Z Detour 1 (Warding Bell) and Detour 2 (flying-bomber Craftmetal). Get the cloak, use the upper currents to reach the upper-left mask puzzle, then defeat Fourth Chorus on the return. Collect the planned hidden 60-rosary string for Mort. Visit Mort before Greymoor: entry 30, Belt 160, pouch 220.
stops.shoppingNote: 410 rosaries for entry (30), Belt (160) and pouch (220). Consume the Seamstress’s 60-rosary string before Mort; reserve another 60 for Greymoor Bellway.

sections.title: Greymoor, Garmond and Zaza, & Moorwing
sections.summary: Open Greymoor travel and meet G&Z before Moorwing.

guide: Reach Halfway Home and open Greymoor Bellway for 60 rosaries.
Collect the Bellway-branch Memory Locket 478035 above the Mitemother. Leave the separate Halfway Home ledge locket 478039, which needs Faydown Cloak.
Exhaust Garmond and Zaza’s first conversation before going to Moorwing.
stops.title: Halfway Home
stops.tip: Open Greymoor Bellway (60), collect locket 478035, and exhaust the first G&Z conversation before Moorwing. Skip the Faydown ledge locket 478039.
stops.shoppingNote: 60 rosaries to open Greymoor Bellway for the later return.

guide: Go west from Halfway Home through the arena. Take the lower-left exit past the centipede, climb the tower, then go left and descend past the scissors.
Open the shortcut back to Halfway Home, then head down toward Moorwing.

After exhausting their first Greymoor conversation, accept Garmond and Zaza’s aid if offered at the marked spot near Moorwing. If absent, the guide suggests encountering the boss, retreating, and reloading from Halfway Home for one check.
Defeat Moorwing. If the duo still does not appear, continue solo; their Moorwing aid is not required for the selected roof-duel and Forum plan.
Continue toward Bellhart and Shellwood. Keep Hunter; skip Reaper (G&Z Detour 3) and Craw Lake’s arena/tools (Detour 4, Checkpoints 3–4).
stops.title: Moorwing defeated
stops.tip: Open the Halfway Home shortcut and defeat Moorwing. Accept G&Z aid if offered, but continue solo if they remain absent after a reload check. Keep the exhausted first Greymoor conversation for the later roof-duel plan.

sections.title: Shellwood, 6th Mask, Cling Grip, & Widow
sections.summary: Take the mask shard, fight Sister Splinter, get Cling Grip, and clear Widow.
sections.mapNote: Joseph’s original, unmarked Shellwood and Bellhart screenshot. Follow the condensed directions and take the normal Sister Splinter fight. The original Steam section map is still missing.

guide: Enter Shellwood from Bellhart. Start along the lower-left wall and climb the platforms in a Z shape to the first arena. Clear it.
The bench immediately after the arena is recommended for 40 rosaries. Continue left and take the elevator down.
At the elevator’s bottom, go right first and open the shortcut door back toward Bellhart. Then continue left toward the room with the bench sign and white roses.
Climb the white roses. At the top, take the LOWER of the two right-side exits and finish the platforming challenge for the Shellwood mask shard.
With Wormways, Pebb and Far Fields already collected, the Shellwood shard completes six masks.
Return left out of the shard room, then take the UPPER right-side exit into the Cling Grip room.
Take the upper Shellwood route and fight Sister Splinter; skip the Phacia pogo at G&Z Checkpoint 2. Keep Hunter and Straight Pin.
After the fight, reach the upper-left part of the Cling Grip room. Go left into the Gahlia room with the long-necked flower enemies, then leave through its TOP-RIGHT exit to obtain Cling Grip.
Continue right through upper Bellhart toward the Widow shortcut.
stops.title: Cling Grip
stops.tip: Clear the arena, use the recommended 40-rosary bench, ride the lift down, and open the right-hand shortcut before going left. White roses: lower right exit for the mask shard, upper right exit for the Cling Grip room. Fight Sister Splinter, then use the Gahlia room’s top-right exit for Cling Grip.

guide: After Cling Grip, continue right through upper Bellhart. Before descending to Widow, drop down-left and break the wall on the left to reconnect to the convenient bench.
Follow the opened shortcut back to the bench and rest before the fight. Use this shorter runback for retries.
stops.title: Widow bench
stops.tip: Before dropping into Widow, open the left breakable-wall shortcut from upper Bellhart and rest at the connected bench. This is the runback that worked on Run #2.

guide: Guide advice for Widow: favor dodging over aggressive attacking. Watch the diagonally bouncing bells, use the gap between their paths, and avoid hugging the opposite wall where they rebound.
Defeat Widow, collect Needolin, and ring the Bellhart bell.
Return to Bellhart for the free first Needle upgrade.
Sell the Mosshome Choral Commandment and any other carried relics to Scrounge in Bellhart before leaving for the return loop. The Commandment sells for 180 rosaries.
Open Bellhart Bellway for 60 rosaries. The next loop takes you to Eva, Atla, Loddie, and Forge Daughter.
stops.title: Widow / Needolin
stops.tip: Defeat Widow, obtain Needolin, ring the Bellhart bell, and get the free first Needle upgrade. Open Bellhart Bellway for the later shopping and upgrade returns. Skip Crawbug Clearing; buy the second Crafting Kit from Twelfth Architect after Clawline.

sections.title: Weavenest Atla, Wanderer Crest, and Deep Docks Mask Shard
sections.summary: Keep Hunter. Visit Eva and Atla, then return for Loddie, the Deep Docks shard, Forge Daughter and spool.
missingMaps: Deep Docks return: mask shard and Forge Daughter
sections.mapNote: The original Atla map is available, but the second map for the Deep Docks return is missing. Use the first-pass Deep Docks reference and the written directions for that part.

guide: From Bone Bottom, drop into Moss Grotto, hug the right wall, and take the first right exit to Atla’s Needolin door.
Use Needolin, power the lift, and visit Eva for Hunter’s first evolution. Skip G&Z Checkpoint 1 (Wanderer Crest).
For the mask shard, approach the lift shaft from below, climb its right wall, and pass the two breakable walls into the platforming room.
For the separate spool branch, climb the east wall from the lower area and go west to the first Marrowmaw.
Take the higher passage, pass the second Marrowmaw, and drop to the fragment. No Moss Mothers fight or double-jump is needed.
Collect the Atla fragment to complete pair A with Bone Bottom: +1 Silk capacity.
stops.title: Weavenest Atla / Eva
stops.tip: Enter Atla from Moss Grotto’s first right exit with Needolin and power the lift. Visit Eva, take the right-shaft breakable-wall mask branch, then the separate upper Marrowmaw route for spool 478230. This completes the first pair with Bone Bottom.

guide: On the post-Widow return through the Marrow, complete both Loddie rounds for the pouch and rosary necklace: 15 targets, then 25. Each attempt costs 25 rosaries; allow at least 50 for the two rounds, plus 25 per retry.
Climb through the upper Marrow with Cling Grip to reach the Deep Docks shard arena. Clear it and collect the mask shard.
If short on shop money, consume the necklace earned from Loddie or collect the nearby rosary pickup dangling from the ceiling in the dark. Check the upcoming spending reminder before buying.
At Forge Daughter, buy the first Crafting Kit for 180 rosaries and Magma Bell for 110 plus the Marrow Craftmetal. Reserve the later Blasted Steps Craftmetal for Cogfly.

For the Deep Docks spool, take the shop’s southwest exit, descend the shaft, and use its first east exit. Cross the burning-floor room, hit the far lever, and return across the platforms. This starts pair B.
stops.mapNote: This is the first-pass Deep Docks map. The return map for the shard and Forge Daughter is missing; follow the directions and pins below.
stops.title: Forge Daughter bench
stops.tip: On the post-Widow loop, complete both Loddie rounds in the Marrow for the pouch and necklace. Collect the Cling Grip mask shard in Deep Docks. Buy Magma Bell (110 + 1 Craftmetal) and the first Crafting Kit (180). The nearby rosary pickup covered the Run #2 shortfall. Collect the selected Deep Docks spool 477926 southwest of the shop: cross the burning-floor room, hit the far lever, and return across the platforms.
stops.shoppingNote: The two Loddie entries cost at least 50 rosaries, plus 25 per retry. The second reward is a 220-rosary necklace you can consume after earning it. Kit and Magma Bell purchases total another 290 rosaries and one Craftmetal; reserve the later Blasted Steps Craftmetal for Cogfly.

sections.title: Greymoor, Garmond and Zaza, & Moorwing
sections.summary: Return with Cling Grip for Bell #3 and the selected Greymoor spool.

guide: Return to Bellhart after the shopping loop.
Use Greymoor Bellway to return toward Halfway Home with Cling Grip.
Continue toward the upper passage for Bell #3 and the Greymoor spool.
stops.title: Bellhart bench after shopping
stops.tip: Return to Bellhart. Use Greymoor Bellway for the Cling Grip return toward Halfway Home and Bell #3.

guide: Climb above and right of Halfway Home, take the top-right transition, and go northeast to Bell #3.
Use Cling Grip and the balloon climb to collect the upper Greymoor spool.
This completes pair B with Deep Docks: +2 total Silk capacity. The Craw Lake arena is not required for this pickup.
Continue toward Shellwood and Blasted Steps. Skip G&Z Detour 4’s Checkpoints 3–4 (Craw Lake arena, Thread Storm, Three-fold Pin) and the Ragpelt farm.
stops.title: Greymoor Bell #3
stops.tip: Climb above and right of Halfway Home, use the top-right transition, then go northeast to the bell. Take the Greymoor spool to complete the second spool with Deep Docks: the documented approach needs Cling Grip and a balloon climb, without double-jump or the Craw Lake arena. Skip the Ragpelt farm.

sections.title: Split Routes: Last Judge or the Mist
sections.summary: Take the Last Judge route through Blasted Steps, then collect the Grand Gate spool.
sections.mapNote: Joseph’s supplied Shellwood → Last Judge → Grand Gate screenshot. Follow the written directions for the Choral Chambers bench and Grand Gate spool; the guide’s checkpoint numbers are not drawn on this map.

guide: Go through Shellwood and Blasted Steps to ring the fifth bell.
Open Blasted Steps Bellway for 60 rosaries. Skip G&Z Judge Detour 1 (Dice gambling); collect Dice free after Dancers.
Take the nearby Memory Locket and free Craftmetal before Last Judge.
Before the fight, equip Magma Bell and check that you have six masks and Needle Upgrade #1.
stops.title: Blasted Steps bench
stops.tip: Ring the fifth bell through Shellwood and Blasted Steps. Open Blasted Steps Bellway for 60 to make the later Dice pickup practical. Grab the nearby Memory Locket and free Craftmetal before Judge. Equip Magma Bell and check six masks plus Needle Upgrade #1.

stops.guideTitle: Last Judge & the Grand Gate spool
guide: With all five bells rung, play Needolin at the Grand Gate and defeat Last Judge.
Take the Grand Gate’s upper-right breakable-wall shortcut to Choral Chambers; skip G&Z Judge Detour 3 (Underworks / Delver’s Drill).
Use the return shortcut for the Grand Gate spool. Climb the balancing platforms, hitting their undersides to tip them into position.
Collect the fragment to start pair C, then continue toward Grand Bellway.
stops.title: Last Judge / Choral Chambers bench
stops.tip: Play Needolin at the Grand Gate after all five bells, beat Last Judge, and rest in Choral Chambers. From the Choral Chambers return shortcut, climb the Grand Gate balancing platforms for spool 478586 before continuing toward Grand Bellway. Hit the scales from underneath to tip them; no extra arena or double-jump is required.

sections.title: Combined Route to Songclave, Lower Cogwork, and WV Arena
sections.summary: Open the travel links, take White Key, defeat Dancers, clear lower Core and the Vaults arena, then rest at Songclave.
missingMaps: Songclave, lower Cogwork and Vaults arena
sections.mapNote: The supplied red route covers the Grand Gate → Grand Bellway → Songclave approach. Dancers, lower Core and the Vaults arena are outside its crop; use their existing references and written directions.

guide: Reach Grand Bellway and open the Bell Beast for 80 rosaries.
Open its Ventrica for another 80 rosaries.
To reach Songclave, climb the rotating-wheel room and take its first right exit. The two Grand Bellway travel unlocks cost 160 in total.
stops.title: Grand Bellway bench
stops.tip: Open the Grand Bellway Bell Beast and Ventrica for 80 each. Keep the map purchase out of the travel budget.
stops.mapNote: Red route: Grand Gate → Choral Chambers → Grand Bellway → Songclave. Use the written steps for travel unlocks and the White Key.

guide: Ring the First Shrine bell in Songclave.
Open the Songclave Ventrica for 80 rosaries. If short, the nearby Grand Reeds on the Dancers approach drop 32 rosaries each.
On the first visit, take the White Key from the corpse at the far right of the First Shrine, before it moves into Jubilana’s stock. Keep it for Whiteward.
stops.title: Songclave bell
stops.tip: Ring the First Shrine bell, open the Songclave Ventrica, and take the White Key for Whiteward.
stops.mapNote: Red route: Grand Gate → Choral Chambers → Grand Bellway → Songclave. Use the written steps for travel unlocks and the White Key.

guide: Defeat the Cogwork Dancers. The guide recommends focusing one dancer because their health is separate.
Continue into lower Cogwork Core.
The free Magnetite Dice pickup becomes available after this fight; collect it on the planned Bellhart upgrade trip.
stops.title: Cogwork Dancers defeated
stops.tip: Beat the Dancers, then head into lower Cogwork. The free Dice pickup is available after the Dancers.
stops.mapNote: Dancers and lower Core are outside the supplied approach screenshot. Use the route overview, written directions and map pins here.

guide: From the bench below Dancers, descend and go left to the lower Core arena. Clear it and collect the mask shard.
Open the middle shortcut, then take the final room’s top-right exit to unlock upper Cogwork Core.
Exit right through the spinning-wheel room toward Whispering Vaults. Skip the lower Core spool branch, unmarked on G&Z maps.
Clear the Whispering Vaults arena (G&Z Checkpoint 6). Exit right, go up and over the large Scrollreader, and strike the ceiling passage to open the shortcut to Songclave. Rest at its bench.
stops.title: Lower Cogwork Core / bench
stops.tip: Collect the lower Core mask shard and open the middle and upper-right shortcuts. Continue through the spinning-wheel room, clear the Vaults arena (G&Z Checkpoint 6), and open the ceiling shortcut to Songclave’s bench. Skip the unmarked lower Core spool.
stops.mapNote: The detailed Dancers, lower Core and Vaults arena map is missing. Use the overview, written directions and existing map pins.

sections.title: Whispering Vaults, 7th Mask, Needle Upgrade, & Trobbio
sections.summary: From Songclave, collect the seventh-mask shard and Pale Oil, upgrade the Needle, pick up Dice, then fight Trobbio.

guide: From Songclave, drop back into Vaults and take the lowest accessible right exit below the Vaultkeeper. Cross the hallway, go right and down through the large room, and take its lower-left exit.
In the next corridor, strike the hidden ceiling and knock the box up to reach the mask shard. This is the planned seven-mask point.
Return below that hidden ceiling and take the lower-left exit for Pale Oil. Hit the lever dividing the large room and exit left above it.

In the Flea box room, go left and up, use the Scrollreader to reach the left platform, and continue left to the Oil box puzzle. Before G&Z Checkpoint 2 (Pale Oil), skip the lower-left breakable-wall arena; it makes Vaultborn spawn permanently.
Return toward the Stage, cross over it, and hit the lever. Take the left exit down toward Grand Bellway for the upgrade trip before Trobbio.
Return to Bellhart for Needle Upgrade #2: one Pale Oil, no rosary charge. Combine this with the Blasted Steps Bellway stop for free Magnetite Dice from Lumble.
Return to Grand Bellway and continue toward Trobbio.
stops.title: Whispering Vaults arena / Songclave bench
stops.tip: From Songclave, follow the lower-right then lower-left mask branch and the dividing-lever/Scrollreader route to Pale Oil. Skip the side arena before G&Z Checkpoint 2 (Pale Oil). Combine free Needle #2 with the Blasted Steps Dice stop before Trobbio.

guide: Defeat Trobbio.
Collect Claw Mirror, then continue right to his lift for the Cauldron route.
stops.title: Grand Bellway bench after Trobbio
stops.tip: Defeat Trobbio, collect Claw Mirror, and continue to his lift for the next chapter’s Cauldron route.

sections.title: The Cauldron, Clawline, Melody #1, & Outer Songclave
sections.summary: Open the lift shortcut, get Injector Band in Whiteward, then take Clawline, Architect’s kit and the last spool pair. Learn the melody and complete the roof duel.

guide: Take Trobbio’s lift down and open the left shortcut door. For the selected Whiteward branch, ride back up before returning to Grand Bellway.
Go west through Choral Chambers and use the White Key lift into Whiteward. Climb in the fireplace room and go all the way left for Injector Band.
Continue through Underworks to Twelfth Architect’s bench. Keep Claw Mirror + Magma Bell through the Cauldron’s heat section; switch from Magma Bell to Injector Band afterward.
Reserve Blasted Steps Craftmetal for Cogfly. Skip G&Z Detour 1 (lower-left Craftmetal puzzle).
From Twelfth Architect’s bench, go left and ride the wind current up and left. Take that room’s bottom-right exit and cross the falling-lava room.
In the next vertical shaft, take the higher left exit with the lever for Clawline.
Clear the arena at the top of the Clawline room to return to the Architect. Use the bench and buy the second Crafting Kit for 450 rosaries; switch to Mirror + Injector Band after the heat segment.
For the eastern Underworks spool, descend the eastern shaft and break into the small lava room from the east.
Collect the fragment to complete pair C with Grand Gate: +3 total Silk capacity.
stops.title: Clawline / Cauldron clear
stops.tip: Open Trobbio’s lift shortcut and take Whiteward for Injector Band. Keep Mirror + Magma Bell through the Cauldron. Get Clawline, buy Architect’s kit (450), and collect eastern Underworks spool 478704 to complete pair C.
stops.shoppingNote: Earn any shortfall in the Citadel before the Cauldron visit. This replaces the 25-Ragpelt farming detour.

guide: Return beneath Trobbio’s lift; skip G&Z Detour 2 (up-left Memory Locket).
Continue right and up to collect the cylinder containing Vaultkeeper’s Melody. Hit the lever outside to open the main room.
Go up and take the first right past the mask puzzle. Solve the next box puzzle and use its hidden upper-right exit.
Follow the wind-current route toward outer Songclave without dropping into Bilewater. Take the Memory Locket in the hidden upper-left room above the wind-puzzle entrance.
If short on rosaries, collect the Heavy Rosary Necklace above outer Songclave’s left exit by alternating Clawline and Glide. It is worth 220; skip this supply stop if funded.
Continue to the far-left roof gate 480502 and open it from the outdoor/eastern side. Leave through it; this roof gate is distinct from the arena’s ceiling shortcut to Songclave.
Return to the Vaultkeeper and have the cylinder played to learn the melody. Turn in spare cylinders for rosaries while here. Rest before returning through the roof gate for the duel.
stops.title: Vaultkeeper's Melody
stops.tip: Collect the melody cylinder below Trobbio’s lift. Take the wind-route locket, open the far-left roof gate, then return to the Vaultkeeper to learn the melody. Rest before returning for the G&Z duel.

guide: Use the open far-left roof shortcut to return to Garmond and Zaza. If the roof is empty, check that gate 480502 was opened from outside, leave, and re-enter.
Win the duel and exhaust Garmond’s dialogue afterward.
Head toward High Halls; skip that map’s Detour 1 (extra G&Z search / late Dice return). Their help is at the Forum door.
stops.title: G&Z duel / Cogwork Core bench
stops.tip: Use the open roof shortcut to return for the duel. Exhaust Garmond's dialogue after winning. Head toward High Halls. The Run #2 split was the Cogwork Core bench after the win.

sections.title: High Halls, Garmond and Zaza, & Melody #2
sections.summary: Prepare Cogfly and the chosen loadout, accept G&Z’s help, and collect Conductor’s Melody.

guide: On the Clawline descent, take the left side room and spend one Craftmetal on Cogfly.
Open the High Halls Ventrica for 80 rosaries and rest at the bench.
At the bench, spend the planned Memory Lockets on any remaining Hunter slots needed for the loadout. Check the actual unlocked sockets.
For the Forum, equip Straight Pin + Cogfly, Claw Mirror + Injector Band, and Weighted Belt + Magnetite Dice. Shard Pendant was for early supplies; the yellow combat pair is Belt + Dice.
Before the Forum, check both pouch upgrades and both Crafting Kits: 6 Cogflies, 18 Straight Pins, and 7 Cogfly damage per hit.
stops.title: High Halls bench with Cogfly
stops.tip: Take the left side room on the Clawline descent for Cogfly (1 Craftmetal). At the bench equip Straight Pin + Cogfly and Claw Mirror + Injector Band, with Belt + Dice. Open the High Halls Ventrica for the Citadel return. Check the 2/4 pouch and damage targets before the Forum.

guide: Accept Garmond and Zaza’s help at the Forum door inside High Halls.

If they are absent after the roof duel and post-duel dialogue, use the guide’s Quit to Menu / Continue fallback and check the Forum door again. Fight the first three enemies solo; the duo joins during a later wave.
Use Cogflies and pins on the dangerous waves while the duo shares the pressure.
Clear the Forum and continue to Conductor’s Melody.
stops.title: High Halls Forum cleared
stops.tip: Accept G&Z's help at the Forum door inside High Halls. Use Cogflies and pins on the dangerous waves and let the duo share the pressure. Run #2 needed three attempts with their help, compared with about eight on scout.

guide: Collect Conductor’s Melody after the Forum.
Return through the Citadel toward upper Cogwork Core.
Use the upper Core shortcut opened on the earlier lower Core visit.
stops.title: Conductor's Melody
stops.tip: Collect the melody after the Forum. Return through the Citadel to upper Cogwork.

sections.title: Cogwork Core, Melody #3, Lace 2, & Grand Mother Silk
sections.summary: Finish the Architect’s Melody, prepare for Lace 2, then defeat Grand Mother Silk.

guide: Climb upper Cogwork Core to the Architect’s Melody puzzle.
From the initial state, hit the levers left to right in the first row: 1–3–3–3.
Second row: 2–0–0–3. Third row: 0–1–1–1. Fourth row: 1–1–0–2.
If a lever has already moved, check the white-line alignment rather than repeating the initial counts.
Collect Architect’s Melody and return toward the final elevator.
stops.title: Architect's Melody
stops.tip: Use the upper Core shortcut and solve the four lever rows. From the initial state, hit left-to-right in each row: 1–3–3–3, 2–0–0–3, 0–1–1–1, then 1–1–0–2. Check the white-line alignment if any lever has moved.

guide: At the Lace 2 checkpoint, decide whether to take the optional Fractured Mask trip below. Leave it if you prefer to continue with Mirror.
Check Injector Band, Weighted Belt + Magnetite Dice, your available Silk, and either Fractured Mask or Claw Mirror.
Confirm all three melodies are learned. When ready, rest for the final approach, play the Threefold Melody at the elevator, and ascend to Lace 2.
stops.title: Checkpoint 1 before Lace 2
stops.tip: At Lace 2, Fractured Mask is an optional late backtrack. If taking it, set Cogwork Core bench 478428 as the return point and rest nowhere else before quitting back. Otherwise keep Mirror + Injector Band. Continue through the final elevator when ready.

optionalDetour.title: Fractured Mask before Lace 2
optionalDetour.detail: Optional when there is enough time left for the pickup and final fights. The timed-file trial included 10 shard bundles from Forge Daughter and the Mask, ended at Marrow bench at 5:06, and was reported as about 10 minutes. That trial rested at Marrow; the Core quit-return below is the planned variant. Scout cleared GMS with Mask and no Mirror.
steps: Before leaving the Citadel, rest at Cogwork Core bench 478428 to set the quit-return point.
If tools need supplies, stop at Forge Daughter for shard bundles on the way. The timed-file trial bought 10 bundles. Do not rest at the Forge Daughter bench if keeping Core as the return point.
Travel back toward the Marrow and Hunter’s March using the unlocked travel routes. Do not rest at any intervening bench, including the Marrow bench.

Rush the scouted Hunter’s March approach, using Cogfly, Straight Pin, and Mirror as needed, past the entrance Skarrgard and central arena to collect the free Fractured Mask. Skip the rosary side trips.
Do not rest at the Hunter’s March bench or take its trap-disabling detour. Use Quit to Menu / Save and Quit, then Continue back at the Cogwork Core bench.
Equip Fractured Mask in Mirror’s blue slot at Cogwork Core. Keep Injector Band and Belt + Dice, then return to the Lace 2 approach.

guide: Let Lace approach and punish her recovery. Patient one- or two-hit openings are enough.
Keep Silk available for Bind and heal in safe openings.
Use Straight Pin only when the opening is safe. Keep Injector Band and Belt + Dice; use Fractured Mask if you took the optional trip, otherwise Claw Mirror.
After winning, continue to Terminus for the final rest.
stops.title: Lace 2 defeated
stops.tip: Let Lace approach and punish her recovery. Keep Silk for healing and use pins in safe openings. Use Fractured Mask if collected on the optional late trip, otherwise Mirror; retain Injector Band, Weighted Belt, and Magnetite Dice.

guide: After Lace, head right and up to rest at Terminus. In the final approach room, take the bottom-right exit and drop to open the runback shortcut. Repair Fractured Mask at the bench if using it.
If low on tool-refill supplies, break into the hidden room on the right wall of the climb to GMS for the large Shell Shard rock before more attempts.
Phase 1 is straightforward: be patient, watch the knives, and take clear openings rather than rushing damage.
During phases 2 and 3, stick to one side. Wait, watch the knives, and prioritize avoiding them.
Save Silk for healing. If Fractured Mask saves you, use a safe opening to Bind and rebuild health; rest between attempts to repair it.
Use Cogflies to maintain pressure when GMS is out of Needle range and the opening is safe.
After winning, record the actual final in-game time in the run log.
stops.title: Grand Mother Silk / finish
stops.tip: Patience is the winning plan. Watch and avoid the knives, stick to one side in phases 2 and 3, and save Silk for Bind. Repair Fractured Mask at Terminus if using it. Run #2 cleared on attempt six at 5:26:16.

research.title: Lace 2 consistency
research.detail: Practice the patient approach and log retries separately from the travel detour. Test Belt plus Injector Band, reserve Silk for Bind, and record safe Straight Pin openings.

research.title: Six fragments, three complete spools
research.detail: Locked by Joseph: Bone Bottom + Atla, Deep Docks + Greymoor, and Grand Gate + eastern Underworks for +3 Silk capacity. No added spool arenas. Skip the central Underworks and lower Core alternatives; the spool decision is closed.

research.title: Buy the second Crafting Kit
research.detail: Joseph reports that earning rosaries in the Citadel is straightforward. Buy Twelfth Architect's kit for 450 after Clawline and skip Crawbug Clearing and the 25-Ragpelt farm.

research.title: Fractured Mask late-game option
research.detail: Optional at Lace 2 when time allows. Scout GMS clear used Fractured Mask with Mirror off. On Run #2, the Forge Daughter restock (10 shard bundles) and Mask trip ended at Marrow bench at 5:06 and was reported as about 10 minutes; Cogfly, Straight Pin, and Mirror were used. For the planned Core return, rest at 478428 before leaving and nowhere else, then quit-return to equip Mask. Keep Mirror if skipping.

research.title: Thread Storm and Craw Lake
research.detail: A documented route takes Thread Storm after Clawline and Faydown Cloak without clearing the arena. The earlier Halfway Home route is verified for Bell #3, and the late spool pickup is separate evidence. Keep Thread Storm skipped for this route.

research.title: Show upcoming purchase costs
research.detail: Checkpoint shopping reminders show the next planned spending stop, item costs, conditional tolls, and materials. Joseph is unsure the early budget will cover everything; the reminders do not assume a wallet balance. Lockets only need to fill Hunter, and both files reportedly have one spare Craftmetal.
